mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 81 degrees. The moon is in its Waxing Gibbous phase, and the space station will be visible at 9:37 PM, moving from Cross Plains in the northwest toward Oregon in the southeast, reaching halfway up the sky. Tonight will cool down to a low of 70 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students to design stickers for the November election. While entries are now closed, the community will be able to vote for the winners from July 28 through August 7. Also, remember to maintain your mailbox area as winter approaches to avoid damage during plowing season.

There is plenty happening today, including the Dane County Farmers Market in Madison and live music at various local spots like Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness this Sunday or join in for trivia at the Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company next Tuesday.
On July 13, officers handled a call involving a 36-year-old Madison man who was arrested for an O-W-I after his vehicle was found stuck on a rock.
You are in luck because today's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. Culvers is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
